title: CARM: Conformal Adaptive Risk Masking for Reliable Scientific Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.06151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning-based super-resolution (SR) can reconstruct fine-scale Earth-observation fields from coarse observations, but reconstruction accuracy alone does not provide a calibrated rule for identifying reliable spatial regions. Conformal Mask Calibration (CMC), built on conformal risk control, converts a spatial uncertainty score into a trust mask and controls the expected worst-case local distortion under exchangeability. However, its fixed threshold can become miscalibrated in Earth-observation streams affected by seasonality and episodic events. We propose $\textit{CARM}$ (Conformal Adaptive Risk Masking), a statistical framework for adaptive spatial risk control under temporal distribution shift. translated_title: CARM：用于可靠科学超分辨率的保形自适应风险掩码
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的超分辨率（SR）技术可以从粗分辨率观测中重建精细尺度的地球观测场，但仅靠重建精度本身并不能提供一个经过校准的规则来识别可靠的空间区域。保形掩码校准（CMC）建立在保形风险控制的基础上，将空间不确定性分数转换为信任掩码，并在可交换性假设下控制预期最坏情况的局部失真。然而，其固定阈值在受季节性和偶发事件影响的地球观测数据流中可能会失去校准。我们提出了CARM（保形自适应风险掩码），这是一个在时间分布偏移下实现自适应空间风险控制的统计框架。CARM维护多个具有异构更新速率的专家，并使用非对称代理损失在线聚合它们的阈值提议，从而在快速适应分布变化与相对平稳时期的稳定性之间取得平衡。
tldr: 提出CARM框架，通过维护异构更新速率的专家并利用非对称代理损失在线聚合阈值，在时间分布偏移下实现自适应空间风险控制，为科学超分辨率生成可靠的信任掩码。
en_tdlr: CARM introduces an adaptive spatial risk control framework that maintains experts with heterogeneous update rates and aggregates their threshold proposals via an asymmetric surrogate loss, providing reliable trust masks for scientific super-resolution under temporal distribution shift.
